Scope: collector and local roads, potable water, sewage, storm drainage, irrigation, TSE, medium voltage, street lighting and telecom networks, a sewage pump station, storm drainage ponds, the boundary fence and guard room, and utility buildings, in the 2nd Industrial City in Dammam.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. The weekly report (WPR-41) gives 40.53% actual against 78.19% planned in the original baseline and 60.75% in the revised plan. No weekly report was built for 10-Nov-2026, so this report covers two weeks: since WPR-39 (03-Nov-2026) the project gained 4.45% (845 man-days), 1.83% of it in the last week.

The forecast delay grew to 119 days. The weekly report forecasts completion on 21-Jun-2027 and the P6 update on 27-Jun-2027 (125 days late), against the contract date of 22-Feb-2027; the completion milestone has −95.5 days of float in P6. Sewage and storm drainage pipe laying picked up (1,512 m and 1,207 m laid, from 331 m and 500 m), but potable water stayed at 390 m. To finish on 22-Feb-2027 the remaining 59.47% must be done in 13 weeks, about 4.57% a week, against 1.83% achieved last week.

The weekly report's forecasts are 4 to 13 days earlier than P6 for most milestones and for project completion (21-Jun-2027 against 27-Jun-2027), but 45 days later for storm drainage (27-Apr-2027 against 13-Mar-2027) and 8 days later for sewage. The Rev.2026.1 version of the same report gives yet other dates, with completion on 28-Jun-2027. Telecom and project completion carry the most negative float (−95.5 days).

Data notes

  • Two weeks: no weekly report was built for 10-Nov-2026. The W07 folder holds only the MODON follow-up dashboard as an MD file (its contractor files, including WPR-40, were not converted), so the change in this report is measured from WPR-39 (03-Nov-2026) to WPR-41 (17-Nov-2026).
  • Week number: the Rev.2026.1 version of WPR-41 states "Current Contract Weeks: 47 of 61", and (17-Nov-2026 − 23-Dec-2025) ÷ 7 = 329 days gives week 47 as well. The original version still shows "0 of 0".
  • Two versions of WPR-41 were uploaded (the original template and Rev.2026.1). Their physical figures agree (40.53% actual, 60.75% revised plan), but they differ on forecast completion (21-Jun-2027, −119 days, against 28-Jun-2027, −126 days), milestone dates, invoices and payments, safety man-hours, FIR and MIR counts, quality score and staff numbers. The P6 update forecasts 27-Jun-2027.
  • Two-week gain: WPR-39 reported 37.09% using 18,474 man-days because it left out sewage; on the full 18,990 man-days it was 36.08%. WPR-41 uses the full budget, so the gain is 7,697 − 6,852 = 845 man-days, 4.45%, not the 3.44% difference of the two headline figures. 36.08% → 38.70% (10-Nov-2026, MODON dashboard and weekly chart sheet) → 40.53% gives +2.62% and +1.83% for the two weeks.
  • The weekly chart sheet rebuilds past weeks from P6 and gives 35.34% for 03-Nov-2026 (the P6 figure WPR-39 noted), not 37.09% or 36.08%. Its baseline uses 106,488 baseline man-hours and gives 80.34% for 17-Nov-2026 against 78.19% on the cover sheet.
  • The cover sheet's planned % for every construction phase is the same 83.0%, and engineering and procurement show 68.43% (last report's total); these are not phase plans. The phase table uses the P6 extract instead.
  • The monthly Physical-Chart Data sheet writes the 17-Nov-2026 actual (40.53%) in the October row, and its forecast column reaches 100% in February 2027, which conflicts with the June 2027 forecast completion.
  • Schedule sheet: 365 completed, 63 in progress and 445 not started, against 378, 65 and 430 in the P6 update itself.
  • Milestones: the weekly report's forecasts do not match the P6 update of the same date (see the Milestones callout); its "latest plan" dates are still earlier than the baseline for most networks.
  • The Conclusion sheet labels cost-based progress as "actual"; it is not used in this report. Its roads earthworks (637,536 of 817,067 m³) and its supply summary are unchanged; the MODON dashboard of 10-Nov-2026 gives 669,995 m³ of earthworks, potable water 250 m (WPR-41: 390 m) and a sewage total of 2,027 m (WPR-41: 2,073 m).
  • Quantities: on the Major Quantities sheet blockwork, bituminous coating and joint sealant are still pro-rated (all 94.4%), so they are not measured values. External paint is shown as 100% complete (16,765 m²) while external plastering is at 25.5%, which is not possible.
  • Procurement tracker: the file dated 17-Nov-2026 is identical in content to the one dated 03-Nov-2026, including the earlier problems (sewage manhole covers 0 of 42, expected delivery dates in December 2027 or in the past, fence concrete note unchanged). The look-ahead schedule in this upload is the one of 10-Nov-2026.
  • Manpower: the trade breakdown adds up to 431 manual workers but the cover gives 421; 421 workers and 156 pieces of equipment are also the figures on the MODON dashboard of 10-Nov-2026, so the head count may not have been updated.
  • Safety: cumulative safe man-hours rose by 25,260 (one week's hours) in two weeks; "this month" (34,260) is close to one week. The HSE inspection sheet is still dated 30-Sep to 06-Oct-2026 and carries project ID DAMT-02-001; the QC inspection is still dated 03-Nov-2026.
  • Invoices: the original cover sheet shows 3 invoices and 0 paid while its own log lists 4 invoices with two paid; the Rev.2026.1 cover shows 14 submitted, 4 approved and 3 paid (6,855,758.91 SAR net). The log still references DAMT-02-001 and a revised contract value of 21,100,000. The MODON dashboard of 10-Nov-2026 shows 14,369,702 SAR from 3 invoices, which matches neither.
  • Photos: one photo was uploaded twice. One photo not used here carries the name of another company (Al-Wafi General Contracting) in its stamp, possibly a subcontractor. The contractor checklist marks all 42 items as done, including the folder structure, although the upload is a flat folder.
